caption: The drawing features a central circular cluster composed of various colorful flowers and leaves, arranged tightly together to form a dense, vibrant bouquet. The flowers within this central circle are depicted in shades of red, pink, blue, orange, yellow, and white, interspersed with green leaves. Around the central circle, there is a wide, pale background that contains smaller motifs of blue, red, and yellow flowers or florets, loosely scattered. Enclosing the entire image is a square border adorned with larger and more defined flowers in pink, red, orange, and blue, as well as green leaves and brownish shadowed areas, forming a decorative frame. The overall color palette is bright and varied, with particular emphasis on reds, blues, greens, and yellows, and the composition alternates between dense floral groupings and airy, open spaces. The background is predominantly light-colored, and the edges are bordered by more saturated floral and foliage motifs.
title: Hooked Rug
